creator: Lee Sharks
description:
This Armature record anchors Rui Tsunoda as a named position in the 2015 New Human cohort. The lead manifestation is *C Harp Hauntir*, and the node notes that this position opens the compiled issue, making it the first voice encountered in the 2015 cohort sequence.

The position’s identity is entirely textual. The New Human charter’s civil-name fold remains in force: no identity or non-identity is asserted between this printed position and any external person sharing the name. The anchor retrospectively canonizes and routes an existing manifestation without inventing a biography.

The opening placement is structurally important. Rui Tsunoda and the closing “Jesus Christ” position frame the issue’s cohort as first and last voices. That sequence relation should be preserved in cross-links because it cannot be recovered from a generic name record.

wiki_article:
**Rui Tsunoda — Provenance Anchor** records the opening named position of the 2015 New Human cohort.

The position’s lead manifestation is *C Harp Hauntir*, printed at the beginning of *New Human Compiled, Ed. 1*. A 2026 Armature record retrospectively supplies provenance and routing.

The civil-name relation remains undisclosed, and the anchor does not identify the position with any external person sharing the name.
